verdict.rationale: Luma documents a public API. The current Luma Agents API runs on a versioned /v1 base with a dated changelog and an X-API-Version header. It has Python/JS/TS SDKs, API keys issued from the platform, and per-endpoint OpenAPI 3.1.0 definitions in the markdown mirrors of the reference pages. Missing for 10: a standalone downloadable OpenAPI spec (openapi.json and swagger paths return 404), a runnable try-it on the current-generation docs (only the legacy docs have one), and independent hands-on corroboration of the official API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
